sum: Wire shape: relX12, relY12, relZ12, angle8. Seen on C2S and S2C.
Wire shape: u32, u32, u32, angle8, u2. Seen on C2S and S2C.
Wire shape: u7. Seen on C2S and S2C.
Wire shape: u32. Seen on C2S and S2C.
Wire shape: s32, array8<u8>. Seen on C2S and S2C.
Wire shape: u6, array8<u8>. Seen on C2S and S2C.

w: u32, u32, u32, angle8, u2, varint, varint, varint, varint
sum: Wire shape: u32, u32, u32, angle8, u2, varint, varint, varint, varint. Seen on C2S and S2C.

C2S empty payload (len=0). Owner sends region0 cmd1 when character-select wait times out (24*5 ticks without Selected()) so the select loop can restart. No S2C receive case in Owner for cmd1. Side effect: re-enters SelectChar wait loop. Wire after u5 cmd: array8 length 0.

S2C login failure during LoginHello wait. Owner switch(g_076C): case 3 maps ConnResult by length: len==1 -> ConnResult(10053); else ConnResult(6). Payload bytes not further unpacked. Ends Owner. Related error cmds in same wait: 5,8,14-19.

S2C: server accepted login. During hello wait, cmd4 -> ConnResult(100), LoadStuff, then either auto-slot (client_variant 1..3) or waits for three 94-byte region0 slot blobs into g_buf_062C[i*94], then SelectChar. Also C2S: after SelectCharacter (delete path) client re-sends cmd4 len0; after EnterWorld wait, cmd4 advances to region7 WorldSnapshot. Payload typically empty. After world snapshot: ConnResult(4), SetPlayerID, LoadSSTW/SetWall, CheckPing, ControlOn.

S2C login failure. Owner switch case 5: ConnResult(5) only. Payload not read. NOTE: catalog sum that unpacks u16 HP/stats into g_rec_0C44 is PlFromBuf of the 94-byte character-select slot blobs received on region0 after LoginOk, NOT cmd5. PlFromBuf(slot) layout (94 bytes): u16 max_hp(i1), u16 mp_max(i3), u16 strength(i6), u16 agility(i7), u16 accuracy(i8), u16 endurance(i9), u16 earth(i10), u16 air(i11), u16 water(i12), u16 fire(i13), u16 pd(i16), u16 md(i17), u8 karma_type(i39), u16 satiety_max(i5), [if slot<=3] u16 title_level_raw(i37), u16 degree_level_raw(i38) then title_rebirth=i37/60, degree_rebirth=i38/60, i37%=60, i38%=60; u32 title_xp(i41), u32 degree_xp(i42), u16 satiety_current(i4), u16 current_hp(i0), u16 mp_current(i2), u16 title_stats_available(i44), u16 degree_stats_available(i45) ( >60000 -> -1 ); u32 model(g_0070), u8 gender(i46), char name[20], u32 model again, 9 bytes wear memcpy g_rec_0898 (from offset 77), u32 g_0A88. Defaults max_hp/mp_max to 100 if <=0.
C2S empty (len0). Sent after LoadSSTW/SetWall finishes and CheckPing is started. Owner has no receive case for cmd6. Marks client world/scene load complete to server.

C2S enter-world with chosen character. Pack: null-terminated character_name (g_buf_0084) then u32 model_or_type (g_0070) immediately after the name NUL. Wire array8 len = strlen(name)+1+4. After send: sysTxt gMsg27; wait for cmd4 (ok) or cmd8 (name conflict -> back to select). Layout Owner.c7 Text(character_name) misses trailing u32 model.

C2S login hello. Pack buf_00BC: u8 client_variant = ffsys.get_global_55F760() at offset 0; from offset 1: login string (login-cache or GETLG) NUL-terminated; then password/PD blob via GETPD NUL-terminated. Length = 2+strlen(login) on cache hit, else extends through GETPD. On cache miss also sets g_0639=1 and g_0638=(byte2!=38). Notifies GETLG/GETPD. Server responds cmd4 or error cmds. Layout Owner.c10 Text(login_blob) is a coarse wrap of variant+login+pd.

C2S: u8 slot in 1..3 (abs(Selected()); negative Selected is delete path but still sends positive slot). Wire len=1. Side effects: HideTotDWindow, SelectChar(slot); delete path also sends cmd4; create/enter path packs EnterWorld cmd7.

Region 1 transform keepalive (Resstop C2S ping; same wire as TransformUpdate). Schema: rel_x 12-bit, rel_y 12-bit, rel_z 12-bit, angle u8. Msg300 origin biases when has_position: origin_x = wire16-32768, origin_y = wire13-1200, origin_z = wire16-32768 (trunc(world)+bias on encode). Each rel_* uses encodeCoordinate/decodeCoordinate: nonlinear 12-bit delta from that axis origin, magnitude must be <120; bit11 (0x800) set when world < origin; absolute = origin + decoded delta. angle raw u8 = trunc(radians * 256 / 2pi) after wrapping negatives (format 'l'); do not show degrees. Resstop loops send of g_rec_0004 xyz + yaw. No MBC receive_callers on _player region1 (engine applies).

Absolute pose snapshot (not 12-bit deltas). Schema: x u32, y u32, z u32, angle u8, flags u2. x/y/z are IEEE float bit patterns of world coordinates (no encodeCoordinate; no 32768/1200 biases on these fields). angle raw u8 = trunc(rad*256/2pi). flags u2 unused in _player MBC (no receive_callers). Engine-native apply; reliable region (flags&1).

Single animation id. Schema: anim_id u7. Manager send sites emit region 3; _player has no region3 receive_caller (peer/_char CheckAnim consumes elsewhere). Related C2S Manager cmd5 SendAnimation also packs anim_id u8 and calls _char.Anim locally. No transforms.

Write one of 60 inventory slots. Wire after ContMan u8 cmd: array8 payload. Fields: slot u8 (index 0..59) -> selects g_arr_1148/g_arr_1240; item_id u24 object-id -> slot_item_id[slot] (g_arr_1148); count u32 -> slot_count[slot] (g_arr_1240). Length variants: len8 full write (slot+item_id+count); len5 slot+count only (keeps item_id); other/short clears item_id and count to 0. Side effects: recomputes bag_total g_1334 = sum of all 60 slot counts. Sender: sendslot packs the same shape (len8, or len1 when clear-flag g_1338 set).

Optional wipe of all inventory slots, then echo one slot. Fields: clear_flag u8 -> g_1338; if nonzero, zeroes all 60 slot_item_id and slot_count and bag_total. Then reads slot u8 and calls sendslot(slot, -5) to broadcast that slot. No other transforms. Side effects: sendslot (region 4 cmd2 and trade region 9 cmd0).

Player ContMan has no dedicated cmd4 body distinct from the post-cmd3 fallthrough. Effective receive: slot u8, then sendslot(slot, -5) echoes that inventory slot (and trade mirror if slot<20). Unlike item ContMan swap (slot_a/slot_b), _player does not swap two slots here. Catalog aliases sendslot/UpdateContainerSlot. Side effects: sendslot only.

Use/interact with a target. Fields: target_id u24 object-id; if payload_len>3, second_id u24 (else -1). Calls Use(target_id, second_id): distance check, UseWith/UseOwner, may use_send_cuse_to_server. Then UseClient() (stub returns 0 on _player). C2S packer use_send_cuse_to_server writes the same 3 or 6 byte body. Side effects: Use, GetTagParent checks, optional TradeTrig/InvOn, CheckUseDist restart.

Client-side use hook. On _player, UseClient() is an empty stub (returns 0); no payload fields consumed. Catalog aliases UseClient. ContMan after cmd7 also calls UseClient. No stores, no transforms. Side effects: none beyond the empty UseClient call.

IMPORTANT: on _player ContMan this is NOT the same if-chain as monster ApplyDamageOrHp. Branch A (payload_len==6): QueryObjectName only. Sends process message 36 field 13 to self, polls until display name string nonempty, copies to local name buf. No HP fields from wire. Branch B (cmd9, len!=6): may store u32 -> g_0A9C (extra weight used by GetWeight = bag_total+g_0A9C). Then if len!=5: u16 current_hp -> g_rec_0C44.i0; if len==6 would also u16 max_hp -> i1 (but len6 already taken by Branch A under cmd9, so absolute max_hp on player rides TradeMan cmd3 len6 instead). If len==5: killer_id u24 + hp_delta u16 with transform raw-30000 (signed); queue ShowKill popup; current_hp += hp_delta, clamp >=0. MISSING vs monster ContMan cmd9: no while(len==4) instant-kill path (monster queues killer + delta=(-1000000-current_hp), forces current_hp=0). On _player that len4 kill lives under TradeMan cmd3 instead. Side effects: ShowKill restart on relative hits; process-36 name query on len6.

Receive stub on _player ContMan: matches cmd10 then continues with no unpack and no stores. Shared-item catalog: C2S often u24 player_id; bags may store first u8 as property 28. No transforms on player. Side effects: none in ContMan receive.

C2S reparent. SetParent() sends region 4 cmd11 with payload_len=3 (parent process id as u24 in g_buf_0804). _player ContMan receive has no cmd11 case (server/item ContMan consumes it). Fields when packed: parent_id u24 object-id. No transform. Side effects: send only from client helper.

Generic signed length + byte blob. Schema: s32, array8<u8>. No send_callers or receive_callers on _player; same shape as _files Ask / other modules' region5. No gameplay stores identified in _player.txt. Treat as unused/opaque for player.

w: array4<u7>, array4<u7>, array4<u7>, u7, u7, u7, u7, u7, u7, u7, u7, u7
sum: Equipment appearance. Schema: three array4<u7> length-prefixed link-model name strings (link0/link1/link2 into g_buf_0854, g_buf_0884, g_buf_086C) plus wear0..wear8 as u7 (g_rec_0898.b00..b08 pattern bytes). Receive null-terminates each name at its length, then ffsys.link_on/off for slots 0,1,2 on model g_0A94, then SetWear -> runtime_pattern_patch (skipped if model==101). No coordinate transforms. Side effects: link_on/off, SetWear.

w: array8<u8>, array4<u8>, s3, varint, u2, u32, u32, u32, u32, varint, array8<u16>, array8<u20>, varint, varint, u3, varint, s6, varint, u4, u32
sum: Full local-player enter-world snapshot (Owner waits on region 7 after LoginOk). Wire fields in order: name_len array8 + character_name bytes -> g_buf_0084; title_len array4 + title bytes -> g_buf_0DCC; name_style_s3 s3 + name_style varint -> g_0DF0; model u2 -> g_0070; gender u32 -> g_rec_0C44.i46; pos_x/y/z u32 float-bits -> g_rec_0004[0] (absolute world, NOT encodeCoordinate; clamp if |coord|>16000); yaw u32 float-bits -> g_rec_0004[1].f0 (clamp if |yaw|>1000); bag_total varint -> g_1334; slot_item_ids array8<u16> -> g_arr_1148; slot_counts array8<u20> -> g_arr_1240; current_hp varint -> i0; max_hp varint -> i1; karma_type u3 -> i39; title_degree varint -> i37 then POST: degree_level i38=i37/100, title_level i37=i37%100; continent s6 -> g_0AB4; block_equip varint -> i21; is_invisible u4 -> i22; money u32 -> i57. Side effects: FillSkinParams/NumToModel if model!=101; start CycleSend + CalcParamCli; SetPlayerID; ConnResult(4); LoadStuff/LoadSSTW/SetWall; CheckPing; CheckOwnImage; ControlOn.

Region 8 fixed schema (not ContMan-style cmd nibble): hit_type u16, hp_delta varint, second_delta/killer_kind varint, flags u3. hit_type==0: environmental/unknown; if flags==6 clears WaitReinc (g_08AA=0). Always tries process msg 49 on hit_type as killer process id for name string. If hp_delta!=0: current_hp += hp_delta; death if current_hp<=0 or flags==7 (Anim 6, WaitReinc, diary/chat); else if hit_type>3 AddEnemy; chat gMsg 120 with hp_delta; heal color vs damage+showred. If second_delta!=0: mp_current i2 += second_delta; chat gMsg 121. No raw-30000 (deltas are signed varints already).

Same wire as cmd0 (hit_type u16=1, hp_delta varint, killer_kind varint, flags u3). Cause-string select by killer_kind: -1 -> gMsg 755, -2 -> 756, -1000 -> 10365, else 750 (death variants 754/757/751). Same HP/MP apply, death, showred, WaitReinc side effects as ReceiveHit.

Same wire (hit_type=3). Cause strings by flags: flags==1 -> gMsg 772, flags==2 -> 770; death -> 773. Also uses shared death texts gMsg 99/103 when hit_type<=0 or >3. Same hp_delta/mp_delta apply path as other RcvInfo cmds.

Same wire (hit_type>=4 typically used as killer process id). Non-lethal hits with hit_type>3 call AddEnemy(hit_type, hp_delta, 0). Death path: Anim(6), WaitReinc, diary, sendSysTextToChat; damage also starts showred and PlaySnd. Chat formats gMsg 120 (hp_delta) and 121 (mp_delta).

Clear one trade-window slot (0..19). Fields: slot u8. Stores: trade_item_id[slot]=-1 (g_arr_0F20), trade_count[slot]=0 (g_arr_1080), trade_slot_extra[slot]=-1 (g_arr_0F78). Decompile also shows len5/longer bodies that rewrite count/extra/item (likely cmd1 bleed). Side effects: none beyond slot clear.

Fill one trade slot after clear. Fields: slot u8; item_id u24 -> trade_item_id[slot]; count u32 -> trade_count[slot] (g_arr_1080); count2/extra u32 -> trade_slot_extra[slot] (g_arr_0F78). Typical body length 12 (sendslot packs this). No signed transforms. Side effects: none beyond writing the three trade arrays.

Update offered trade quantity / peer id. Fields: slot u8; count u32 -> g_arr_0FD0[slot] (offer count); if payload_len>5: extra_id u24 -> g_arr_1028[slot], else g_arr_1028[slot]=-1. Side effects: echoes same bytes as TradeMan cmd1 to -5; also send_message_marshaled(12, 7, ...) (Manager SetTradeOffer) with the same payload.

Shared gold + HP command (same length mux as monster TradeMan cmd3). Always first: gold u32 -> g_0AB0; notifies process0 opcode 17 (gold UI) with g_0AB0. Then length-discriminated HP (same buffer): len!=5: while len==4: killer_id u24, force popup delta=(-1000000-current_hp), current_hp=0, start ShowKill; else u16 current_hp -> g_rec_0C44.i0; if len==6 also u16 max_hp -> i1. len==5: killer_id u24 + hp_delta u16 transform raw-30000; queue ShowKill; current_hp += hp_delta, clamp>=0. This is where _player keeps the len4 instant-kill path that ContMan cmd9 lacks. Side effects: process0/17 gold notify; ShowKill.

Catalog aliases restart:ShowKill. _player TradeMan if-chain has no explicit cmd==4 unpack body; damage popups are started from cmd3/ContMan relative-HP paths via program_restart(ShowKill). Treat as ShowKill trigger / empty or opaque array4 payload. Side effects: ShowKill when used that way.

System chat line by gMsg id. Fields: gmsg_id u8; color u32 RGB. Calls sendSysTextToChat(gMsg(gmsg_id), color). Additional length variants after the chat send: len2 u16 effect_id -> effect_attach(model, effect_id) if model>0 and not g_0DED; len4 stores u8 -> g_07CA (action/state flag). Side effects: sendSysTextToChat; optional effect_attach.

Title/karma style fields (not HP bar). Length variants: len1: u8 -> karma_type g_rec_0C44.i39. else: u8 title_level -> i37; u8 degree_level -> i38. Follow-on name_style path: if first payload byte==5 clears name (style -1, empty string) via process-36 fields 14/13; else sets name_style g_0DF0=3 and copies remaining bytes to display-name buf, notifies process-36 fields 14 then 13. No raw-30000. Side effects: process-36 display-name / name-style updates.

Ranged/projectile FX. Fields: target_id u24; shot u16; calls FlyWeapon(self, target_id, shot) which notifies GEFF and starts FlyFire. If payload_len==4: also u32 -> g_rec_0C44.i20 (specab[0] dword). No coordinate transforms. Side effects: GEFF, FlyFire.

Animation gate / lock. Fields: anim_lock u32 -> g_0ADC (also used as teleport lock in Teleport()). If g_0ADC>0: yield then _char.Anim(7). No other wire fields in the cmd13 path. Side effects: Anim(7).

Item name suffix for GetInfo. Length variants: len1: suffix_enabled g_0B10=1; suffix_id u8 -> g_0B1C; GetInfo appends GetSysText(3000+suffix_id). len2 catalog mentions two grade/suffix bytes; _player receive path only clearly handles len1. Side effects: changes GetInfo display string; EInit may re-send cmd14.

Write one g_rec_0C44 field by index. Fields: stat_index u8; then value u16 if len==3 or u32 if len==5, stored at &g_rec_0C44 + 4*stat_index. Semantic names via index: 0 current_hp, 1 max_hp, 2 mp_current, 37 title_level, 39 karma_type, 57 money, etc. No raw-30000. Side effects: direct stat store only.

Region 10 schema: cmd u6 + value varint. CheckPing case 37: busy-waits while title_level i37 == value, then sprintf gMsg 128 with ability name gMsg(300 + value*2 + gender i46); sendSysTextToChat + AddToDiary; clears title_xp i41=0; Effect(130). Finally stores value at g_rec_0C44[37] (title_level). No raw-30000.

Region 10 cmd 42: value varint is new degree_xp (i42). delta = value - degree_xp; if delta!=0 and prior i42>=0, chat gMsg 127 with delta (green if >0, red if <0). Then stores value at g_rec_0C44[42]. Side effects: sendSysTextToChat only (no Effect).

Periodic movement stream. Schema array4<u32>: count nibble then N u32 words. CycleSend sends count=4 with &g_rec_0004[0] (pos_x, pos_y, pos_z, yaw as float bit patterns). Absolute floats (not encodeCoordinate). Rate adapts to distance traveled (thresholds 1 / 9 / 18 world units over a 16-tick window). While current_hp<=0 keeps sending and waits. CheckPing receive on region 11 resets connection-loss timer (does not re-parse into pose). Distinct from region1 12-bit keepalive.

S2C: u32 format_arg, u32 rgb_color. sprintf(gMsg(79), format_arg) then sendSysTextToChat(text, color). C2S pickup/group action (no local send site for cmd1 in _player.txt). Layout Manager.c1 actor_id+color (format_arg is gMsg79 %d).

Bidirectional chat. C2S sendChatMsgByParts(channel, text): if strlen>4096 sends Manager.cmd34 with u8=3; else header kind=1: u8 channel, u8 kind=1, u32 text_length, u16 chunk_count=ceil(len/250), send len=8; then per chunk kind=2: u8 channel, u8 kind=2, u16 chunk_index, up to 250 text bytes (last=remainder), send len=8+n+1. S2C mgrChat via assembleChatMsg; on complete, channel selects routing/color (12/5/4/15/16 special; 16 parses space-separated sys/chat). Dest: process0 chat / IgnoreSender. Layout UnpackChat matches.
S2C: u24 weapon_process_id -> g_08F4; send_to_process_id(weapon, 50) then InitWeapon. Layout Manager.c4.
C2S SendAnim: u8 anim_id; also _char.Anim locally. S2C: send_message_marshaled(3, *buf) echoes first payload byte onto AnimationState region3. Wire: 1 byte.

mgrSetTrade length variants. Always u8 slot_index (0..19). len==12: +u24 item_id (g_span_0F20[slot]) +u32 count (g_span_1080) +u32 trade_extra (g_span_0F78); if item state==701 and IsChestEmpty>0 -> SKeyAlarm; relays to TradeMan (-5,9). len==9: +u32 count +u32 trade_extra. else: clear slot ids to -1. Then clears trade_slot_extra[slot], sends region9 cmd1 with slot.

mgrSSetOffer: u8 slot_index (0..19), u32 offer_count (g_span_0FD0[slot]), u24 counterparty_process (g_span_1028[slot]). If offer_count>0: resolve names via process-23, sprintf gMsg108, sendSysTextToChat green. Client C2S also packs offers on cmd7 with len g_07FC.
C2S BuyIt: u24 item_id, u24 merchant_id, u32 price, u32 count (14 bytes). S2C mgrBuyIt: u24 target_id, u32 price, u32 count; builds purchase sys text (gMsg 10218/10219/10201/131). Layout Manager.c8.

mgrSSysMsg: u8 mode then variants. mode0: u16 gmsg_id + u32 color -> sendSysTxt2ChatByNum. mode2: +u16 arg sprintf gMsg. mode3: +u16 smsShowWindow. mode4: rest text sprintf. mode5: smsShowWindow text. mode6 subtype51: five u16 gmsg ids + u32 value then smsWindowMessage1. mode7: chat raw. mode8: u16 nested gMsg. mode>10 uses full receive length g_0770 (6/10/>10). Always AddToDiary. C2S SendSys* packs mode0 len7; mode2/3 len9; mode4 variable.

C2S enableFistPwr: 1 byte, setFistPowerups(2) locally. S2C mgrFist by len: len==1 u8 flag (1=closeEvacPlayerWin; 2=setFistPowerups(2); default setFistPowerups(3)). len==11: float32 x, float32 z, u24 process_id; if process_id==self -> FFLBP(x,z). Not SignedMinus30000 (catalog mis-tag). Layout Manager.c10 u8 enabled covers C2S.
S2C: u16 clan_x_raw, u16 clan_z_raw. Transform SignedMinus30000: clan_x=raw-30000, clan_z=raw-30000. Calls _pcontrol.SetClanXZ(clan_x, clan_z). Layout Manager.c11 Hp16 clan_x/clan_z.
mgrTable: u16 table_opcode, remaining bytes as C-string (NUL forced at len). send_to_process_id(self, TTAX, opcode, text_ptr). Town/workshop table UI.

mgrSBought: u24 item_process, u24 qty_or_related, u24 party_process, u32 amount, u24 alt_item_process, u16 type_flag. type_flag==10 shows amount as '%d$'; else resolve item name via process-23. sprintf gMsg107 to chat; decrements matching trade slot counts (g_arr_1080/0F20/0F78).
mgrKey by len: len1 -> restart mgrCheckKey (KeyAlarm). len4: u32 -> g_81D8, restart WinLink. len5: u32 -> g_0078. C2S also sends len1/5 for link helpers.
mgrSetCoord when len>=12: float32 x,y,z (12 bytes); if len>12 also float32 yaw else keep current ABG yaw. Copies to g_rec_6FB4, restarts PrgMove. Logged SETCOORD. Requires g_0A94>0.

mgrSrvJump by len: len1 sets g_07E4=1. len2: u16 -> g_1684 (target continent/server). Also typed_store u8 -> g_0418 from buffer start. CheckServer C2S can send len16 float pose blob on cmd16 when changing SRV. Side effects: LoadSST, ShadowOn, reconnect URL.

S2C mgrElem: eight u32 skill adds (32 bytes) applied onto g_rec_0C44.i27.. (strength, agility, accuracy, endurance, earth, air, water, fire). Clamped by title_stats_available(i44) for first4, degree_stats_available(i45) for last4, and stats_available(i43); decrements those pools. Layout UnpackSkillAdds names strength+..fire+.

mgrEffect by len: len1 clears g_07C9. len2: u16 effect_id; if 600 sets g_07C9; effect_attach(g_0A94, effect_id). Other len: u8 ask_flag -> g_8F8C, restart mgrEffectPrg (clan symbol InitClanSymb/UpdateClanSymb). Layout effect_flag/effect_id.
When len==3: u24 process_id; process-23 type2 fetches name; sprintf gMsg116; sendSysTextToChat orange. LostItem also C2S-sends this. Layout Manager.c19.
S2C Manager action flag. Fields: action_flag u8 -> g_07CA (client activity/state latch). No length variants. Layout Manager.c20.
u24 target_player_id -> g_10DC / mgrTradeWith (STW path when state==2 in dead branch). C2S packs u24. Layout Manager.c21.

mgrSetClan. len==1 special: *arg0 membership delta -> g_0DF0 / gMsg138 or leave gMsg139. Else first u8 op: 0..3 rank change gMsg160; 4=u24 prayer_id AddPrayer; 5=leave msgs 161/163 clear clan; 6=set rank3 + strcpy clan name from rest, gMsg162. C2S packs op4+u24 etc.

mgrSrClan: u8 op then variants. op1 add: byte1 rank, bytes2..4 u24 id, from byte5 name; 21-byte entries in g_buf_0EDC, count g_0DFC<99. op2 remove by name. op3 update rank by name. op4 remove by u24 id. op5 update rank by u24 id. mcl() alloc 21*100.

mgrSetGroup: u8 op then fields. op6: u32 groupState, u32 onlineState, name -> lsGroup. op10: name delete + refreshWinGroupList. op11/13: destroy lsGroup + stopWinGroupExist. op12: u32 state + name add + refresh. op5: create lsGroup. op8: u32,u32,name update. op9: createNewGroupOnClient. C2S: group_new op0; joinCandidate op1+name; joinSomeone op2+name; deleteSomeone op3+name; groupDelete op4; deleteMe op7.
When len==5: u24 target_id, u16 shot_id -> FlyWeapon(self, target, shot) which GEFF + FlyFire. Layout Manager.c26.

mgrCheckCrc by len: 1=process_state_reset if needed; 2=alloc CRC buffers, restart WaitForCrcThreadEnd (client replies with two cmd27: 5*u32 continent loads, then (crcCount+1)*u32); 3=restartUpdater; >3 bind update strings (xupdate rewrite).

S2C accumulator into span_09BC (160 bytes). Waits until v_09B4>=21 words then memcpy payload and v_09B4 += len/4. Catalog name GrabItem is wrong here; real grab is cmd31. Multi-packet blob assembly (anticheat/CRC companion).
Like cmd29 but waits v_09B4>=25, appends, sets latch v_A59C=1 (once). Catalog GetBonus wrong; real bonus is cmd32.
mgrGrab when len==10: u24 src_or_container, u24 item_process, u32 count. Resolves names via process-49/23/36; sprintf gMsg780+/783+; sendSysTextToChat red. Layout Manager.c31 u24 item_id is partial.

Manager.cmd32 GetBonus = mgrGetBonus(buf, payload_len_bytes). len1: u8 prize_slot_count; 0 opens empty smsShowPrizeWindow. len2: both payload bytes IGNORED; client only program_restart(smsInfoIcon) then smsShowPrizeWindow (corner bonus icon UI). len>2: u8 prize_slot_count then pairs of u32 item_process + u32 amount (resolve name via process msg 23), then smsShowPrizeWindow.
mgrCheat: u8 code; if code==19 rest is login-ish string ending with digit slot -> rewrite *LOGIN and Reconnect. C2S Sheat packs various cheat/report blobs (len1/5/17/variable) on cmd33.

C2S: chat oversize flag u8=3 (from sendChatMsgByParts). S2C runMgrAnticheat: memcpy payload to g_buf_9BA4, g_9B9C=len, restart mgrAnticheat (CRCERR restart / Ensc / process-list via further cmd34 / halt).

mgrAlly: u8 op + rest. op0/1/5 AskAlly(op, name). op20 SetAllyList. op21/22 chat gMsg870/871. op30/31 clanlist_*.xls dump. C2S SendAllyAsk: u8 op + name. Layout Manager.c36 target_id+name incomplete vs op-prefixed shape.

mgrTmntAction: cstring name, u8 action; lookup lsTmntPlayers then patch: act0 u8, act1 u8, act2 u32 rec.i3, act3 u32 rec.i4, act4 u8 rec.b14. UpdateTmntWin.
mgrTmntDrop: u8 is_gvg, u8 tmnt_type; if is_gvg: copy next 16 bytes into getLastGVG, clear lsTmntResults; else u8 state -> SetTmntState, clear lsTmntPlayers. SetTmntType; UpdateTmntWin.
mgrTmntDone: u8 done_code -> getTmntData.i0; if code 3 or 4 copy 16 bytes to getLastGVG; move all lsTmntPlayers into lsTmntResults; UpdateTmntWin.
mgrTmntState: u8 state, u8 type. SetTmntState; case1/2 SetTmntType; case2 SetTmntTimeLeft(-1); case0 clear type/state and drop first lsTmntPlayers. UpdateTmntWin.
mgrTmntData: tournament blob. Fields: opaque payload bytes forwarded to ReceiveTmntData(arg1). No per-field unpack in _player Manager; treated as opaque array8 body.
mgrTmntShowState: triggers ShowTmntStateGVG on self; payload ignored beyond translate.

u32 -> closeCustomerWorkshop -> UseOff on process. C2S callCloseCustomerWorkshop.
